description: Candidate authors matching a name, so you can pick the right one before listing their papers. Each line shows the OpenAlex author id, the name as OpenAlex writes it, and how many works and citations that profile has. Inputs: name (required, the author name to look up, for example Jane Doe). Example prompt: 'find authors named John Dewey'.

name.description: The author name to look up, for example Jane Doe.

name: find_authors
title: Find authors by name
